events.title: Planes %26 Horsepower Car Show
events.description: Planes and Horsepower is back for its 11th year! The Utah Wing of the Commemorative Air Force is pleased to host one of Utah's most unique car shows. Patrons can bring their vehicles to get a unique photo op with very rare WWII aircraft. You will have as a souvenir from the show digital files of your photo op and physical prints as an optional bonus. Pre-registering for the show is strongly recommended, as we often fill up our available space in the airport about a week before the show. Proceeds from the show benefit the CAF UT-Wing aviation museum and assist us in our mission of preserving these historic aircraft in airworthy condition.

events.title: Dominick Antonelli @ Cafe Galleria
events.description: Live Summer Music Series May through September (weather permitting) Every day but Mondays from 5:30pm – 8:30pm Sundays 10am – 1:30pm Dominick has been playing guitar for 21 years and writing original music for 15+ of those years. He looks at himself not as a guitar player, but an artist who utilizes the guitar and other forms to create an inspiring, healing, and contemplative experience for himself and listeners. Alternate tunings and intuitive playing have contributed immensely by shaping the instrumental and lyrical music that comes through him. He has a background in Integrative Health and is currently studying Music and Recording Arts Technology which is taking his creative possibilities to new depths and heights. He has performed at festivals in Thailand, Costa Rica, and the East Coast (US), as well as in yoga classes, local gigs, and workshops where he incorporates live music, meditation, group energy healing and writing into one experience. He loves performing live and sharing the gifts that continue to be cultivated. Read more about Dominick
events.location: Cafe Galleria, 101 West Main Street

events.title: Park City Opera Presents: Roméo et Juliette
events.description: Friday, August 21, we’re throwing a party at the Eccles Center. Have dinner on Main Street first. Then come early: the lobby is done up with art and history displays and themed concessions, and there is no wrong amount to dress up. Curtain call is at 7:00 PM. Gounod’s Roméo et Juliette opens at a masked ball in Verona. Two strangers see each other across a crowded room and decide, immediately and disastrously, that this is it. You might already know the rest of the story. Meet the cast here! Forty musicians. A twelve-voice chorus. Dancers from Ballet West II. Four duets that are, quite simply, glorious. Sung in French, with English supertitles, so you won’t miss a word of it. We can’t wait to see you there! Buy Tickets here. Learn More here....

events.title: Serve Park City: Barbed Wire Pull on the 910 Ranch
events.description: Join Summit County for a barbed wire pull at the 910 Ranch! Enjoy a hands-on day of stewardship and community connection! We’ll work together to remove decommissioned barbed wire fencing, helping to restore wildlife movement and improve the health of the landscape. What to Bring & Wear: Wear long pants, long sleeves, and sturdy closed-toe shoes or boots. Pack sun protection (hat, sunglasses, sunscreen), water and snacks, and layers in case of changing weather. Please bring sunglasses to act as protective eyewear! Participants should bring thick, sturdy gloves for their protection and wire cutters if they have them. Summit County has a limited number of gloves and wire cutters to borrow. Safety Notice: Participation in barbed wire removal can be dangerous. Hazards may include cuts, punctures, scrapes, tripping, heavy lifting, sharp edges, and exposure to rusted metal or other environmental risks. By signing up and attending this activity, you acknowledge these risks, accept full responsibility for your participation, and agree to the terms of the waiver. A recent tetanus vaccination is recommended, though it is not required. Your safety is our priority—please work carefully, follow instructions, and look out for one another. This is a great opportunity to roll up your sleeves, meet like-minded people, and directly help enhance one of our community’s treasured open spaces....
events.location: 910 Cattle Ranch, Park City, Utah
